title: Interactive rectangular crop
summary: Drag a crop rectangle, move or resize its handles, then apply or cancel. One Undo restores your image and editable objects.

Added: Crop tool with eight handles, reverse-direction drawing, movement, thirds grid, live dimensions and outside shading.
Properties hide while cropping. Crop/Cancel controls stay near the selection; projects with objects show an explicit Flatten and crop action.
Verified: 130 Rust tests, formatting and strict Clippy; exact transparent-pixel crop, source retention, invalid inputs, persistence, boundary clamping and draft cancellation.
Native reverse drag, move, resize, Cancel, one-step Undo/Redo, saved output and actual OS clipboard comparisons.

limitations: Applying crop flattens the complete composite. Undo restores the previous editable objects; non-destructive off-canvas object editing remains unfinished.
Trim, crop aspect presets, numeric crop entry, object rotation and grouping remain planned.
Unsigned Windows x64 alpha. Full Snagit UI/behavior parity is not claimed.
